en.headline: Police arrest man over pouring liquid on women at Tsim Sha Tsui MTR
en.dek: A 26-year-old man faces three indecent assault charges and one wounding charge after incidents in January and early October at the station and a nearby mall.
body: Police arrested a 26-year-old local man in Kwun Tong on Thursday on suspicion of indecent assault and wounding after he allegedly poured an unknown liquid on women at Tsim Sha Tsui MTR Station and a nearby shopping mall.

According to police, a 28-year-old woman reported on Monday that a man had poured liquid on her while she was on an escalator inside Tsim Sha Tsui Station on 2 October. She tried to stop him leaving and injured a finger in the struggle. Investigations linked the same man to two similar incidents involving other women in January at the station and a mall in the area.

The suspect, who works as an IT technician, remains in custody. Police said he would be charged with three counts of indecent assault and one count of wounding, and would appear at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Saturday. Officers searched his home and recovered clothing he was believed to have worn during the incidents.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀港鐵站淋液體案 警方拘捕26歲男子
zh.dek: 男子涉嫌在一月及十月初於港鐵尖沙咀站及附近商場向女性淋潑不明液體，將被控三項猥褻侵犯及一項傷人。
body: 警方周四在觀塘區拘捕一名26歲本地男子，涉嫌在港鐵尖沙咀站及附近商場向女性淋潑不明液體，涉「猥褻侵犯」及「傷人」。
警方表示，一名28歲女子本周一報案，指本月2日在尖沙咀站內乘扶手電梯時，有男子向她淋潑不明液體。她試圖阻止對方離開時手指受傷。調查發現該男子今年1月亦曾在尖沙咀站及附近商場以相同手法向另外兩名女子犯案。
被捕人報稱任職資訊科技技術員，現正被扣留調查，將被暫控三項「猥褻侵犯」及一項「傷人」罪，案件明日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。警方搜查其住所，檢獲其犯案時所穿衣服。
